newsitem.title: CHINA: China Development Bank rail loans at 32.8 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Development Bank rail loans at 32.8 bln yuan.

text.p: China's State Development Bank, has extended 2.226 billion yuan ($268 million) in loans for new railway construction projects in the first quarter, the People's Daily said on Monday.
That brought its total loans to 48 railway projects in China to 32.8 billion yuan, it said.
The bank had extended loans of 13-14 years for railway projects, five years longer than the normal eight-year term offered by domestic commercial banks, it said.

The bank would continue to give priority to railway development and the proportion of loans for the railway, power, oil and natural gas and petrochemical sectors would account for 50 percent of the total in the coming five years, compared with 47 percent at present, it said.
